license_required.quote: No person shall knowingly conduct a home inspection or represent a qualification to conduct a home inspection for compensation or other valuable consideration unless that person is licensed pursuant to this chapter as a home inspector or performing a parallel inspection.

issuing_authority.value: Superintendent of Real Estate and Professional Licensing
issuing_authority.quote: The superintendent of real estate and professional licensing shall do all of the following: ... issue a home inspector license to, or renew a home inspector license for, any person who satisfies the requirements specified in this chapter

name.value: Superintendent of Real Estate and Professional Licensing (with Ohio Home Inspector Board)
name.quote: The superintendent of real estate and professional licensing shall do all of the following: ... issue a home inspector license to, or renew a home inspector license for, any person who satisfies the requirements specified in this chapter

type.quote: The Ohio home inspector board is a part of the department of commerce for administrative purposes. The director of commerce is ex officio the executive officer of the board, or the director may designate the superintendent of real estate and professional licensing to act as executive officer of the board.

umbrella_agency.quote: The Ohio home inspector board is a part of the department of commerce for administrative purposes.

age_minimum.quote: Proof that the applicant is at least eighteen years of age

moral_character_required.quote: Failed to establish to the satisfaction of the superintendent that the applicant is honest and truthful

degree_required.value: Graduated from the twelfth grade, received a GED, or satisfactorily completed an equivalent program; plus completion of an approved curriculum of at least 80 hours of prelicensing instruction
degree_required.quote: Proof that the applicant has graduated from the twelfth grade, received a general educational development diploma, or satisfactorily completed a program that is the equivalent to graduating from the twelfth grade or receiving a general educational development diploma

accrediting_body.value: Board-approved institution or organization (accredited public or private institution of higher education or professional organization)
accrediting_body.quote: The curriculum is offered by an accredited public or private institution of higher education or a professional organization that has been approved by the board to offer a curriculum.

degree_level.quote: Proof that the applicant has graduated from the twelfth grade, received a general educational development diploma, or satisfactorily completed a program that is the equivalent to graduating from the twelfth grade

school_approval_basis.quote: a professional organization that has been approved by the board to offer a curriculum

credential_pegged.quote: Proof of successfully completing a curriculum of education approved by the board in accordance with rules the board adopts pursuant to division (A)(3) of section 4764.05 of the Revised Code

required.quote: Proof that the applicant has experience in the field of home inspections through either of the following: (a) Successful completion of a curriculum of experience approved by the board ... (b) Successful completion of ten parallel inspections or equivalent experience

experience_source.quote: Proof that the applicant has experience in the field of home inspections through either of the following: (a) Successful completion of a curriculum of experience approved by the board in accordance with rules the board adopts pursuant to divisions (A)(4) and (D) of section 4764.05 of the Revised Code; (b) Successful completion of ten parallel inspections or equivalent experience

duration.value: At least 40 hours of work in the home inspection field OR 10 parallel inspections
duration.quote: a person, to successfully complete the curriculum, must perform at least forty hours of work in the home inspection field that allows the person to obtain practical experience or training regarding home inspections

kind.value: field experience curriculum or parallel inspections
kind.quote: Successful completion of ten parallel inspections or equivalent experience as determined by the board

exams.name: National Home Inspector Examination
exams.notes: Must be passed within two years before the date of application
exams.quote: Proof of successfully passing, within two years before the date of the application, the national home inspector examination

interval_years.quote: A home inspector license issued or renewed pursuant to this chapter expires three years after the date of issuance or renewal.

required.quote: During each three-year period that a license is valid, a licensed home inspector shall successfully complete not less than fourteen hours of continuing education instruction annually

hours_per_period.quote: not less than fourteen hours of continuing education instruction annually

period_years.quote: not less than fourteen hours of continuing education instruction annually in courses or programs directly applicable to the standards of practice

value: requirements specified in rules adopted by the Ohio home inspector board
topical_requirements.quote: courses or programs directly applicable to the standards of practice and requirements specified in rules adopted by the Ohio home inspector board pursuant to division (A)(10) of section 4764.05 of the Revised Code

available.quote: The board shall issue a home inspector license in accordance with Chapter 4796. of the Revised Code to an applicant if either of the following applies: (1) The applicant holds a license in another state.

requirements.value: Applicant must hold a license in another state (or have satisfactory work experience, government certification, or private certification in a state that does not issue such a license); for non-state jurisdictions, the other jurisdiction must grant the same privileges to Ohio licensees and have substantially similar requirements.
requirements.quote: The superintendent of real estate and professional licensing may issue a home inspector license to an applicant who holds a license, registration, or certification as a home inspector in another jurisdiction other than another state if that applicant submits an application ... and satisfies all of the following requirements: (1) The applicant is licensed, registered, or certified as a home inspector in a jurisdiction that the board determines grants the same privileges to persons licensed under this chapter as this state grants to persons in that jurisdiction. (2) That other jurisdiction has licensing, registration, or certification requirements that are substantially similar to, or exceed, those of this state.

exists.quote: There is hereby created the Ohio home inspector board consisting of seven members.

regulatory_model.quote: No person shall knowingly conduct a home inspection or represent a qualification to conduct a home inspection for compensation or other valuable consideration unless that person is licensed pursuant to this chapter as a home inspector or performing a parallel inspection.

credential_type.quote: The superintendent shall issue a license to perform home inspections to applicants who satisfy the requirements set forth in this section

is_mandatory.quote: No person shall knowingly conduct a home inspection or represent a qualification to conduct a home inspection for compensation or other valuable consideration unless that person is licensed pursuant to this chapter as a home inspector

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failed to establish to the satisfaction of the superintendent that the applicant is honest and truthful
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failed to establish to the satisfaction of the superintendent that the applicant is honest and truthful

disciplinary_grounds.description: Accepted compensation from more than one interested party for the same service without written consent
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Accepted compensation or other valuable consideration from more than one interested party for the same service without the written consent of all interested parties

disciplinary_grounds.description: Accepted commissions or allowances from other parties involved in a real estate transaction related to the inspection
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Accepted commissions, allowances, or other valuable consideration, directly or indirectly, from other parties who deal with a client in connection with the home inspection for which the home inspector is responsible

disciplinary_grounds.description: Repaired, replaced, or upgraded systems or components in an inspected residential building prior to the close of the related real estate transaction
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Repaired, replaced, or upgraded, or solicited to repair, replace, or upgrade, for compensation or other valuable consideration, systems or components in a residential building after completing a home inspection of that residential building, but prior to the close of the real estate transaction associated with that home inspection

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failed to disclose in writing any business interest that may affect the client before entering into a written contract
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failed to disclose to a client in writing and before entering into a written contract with the client information about any business interest of the home inspector that may affect the client in connection with the home inspection

disciplinary_grounds.description: Pleaded guilty to or been convicted of a crime of moral turpitude, felony, or equivalent offense, or required to register under sex offender chapter
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Pleaded guilty to or been convicted of any crime of moral turpitude, a felony, or an equivalent offense under the laws of any other state or the United States, or was required to register under Chapter 2950. of the Revised Code

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failed to maintain or provide copies of records to the superintendent or failed to cooperate with an investigation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failed to maintain or provide copies of records to the superintendent as required by section 4764.11 of the Revised Code or failed to cooperate with an investigation conducted by the superintendent under section 4764.12 of the Revised Code

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failed to maintain, be covered by, or submit proof of required general liability insurance at any point during a prior license term
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failed to maintain, be covered by, or submit proof of a comprehensive general liability insurance policy or a commercial general liability insurance policy as required under division (A) of section 4764.11 of the Revised Code at any point during the term of a prior license

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violated rules adopted under the home inspector board statute or otherwise not in compliance with the chapter
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violated rules adopted under section 4764.05 of the Revised Code or is otherwise not in compliance with this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failed to submit proof of satisfying the continuing education requirements
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failed to submit proof of satisfying the continuing education requirements specified in section 4764.08 of the Revised Code

insurance_required.quote: Every licensed home inspector shall maintain, or be covered by, a comprehensive general liability insurance policy or a commercial general liability insurance policy with coverage limits of not less than one hundred thousand dollars per occurrence and not less than a three-hundred-thousand-dollar aggregate limit.

definition_quote.value: Home inspection means the process by which a home inspector conducts a visual examination of the readily accessible components of a residential building for a client. 'Home inspection' does not include pest inspections; environmental testing; inspection of any property or structure conducted by an employee or representative of an insurer; or determination of compliance with applicable statutes, rules, resolutions, or ordinances, including, without limitation, building, zoning, or historic codes.
definition_quote.quote: "Home inspection" means the process by which a home inspector conducts a visual examination of the readily accessible components of a residential building for a client.

value: visual examination of readily accessible components of a residential building
methods_authorized.quote: the process by which a home inspector conducts a visual examination of the readily accessible components of a residential building for a client

minimum_inspections_for_licensure.quote: Successful completion of ten parallel inspections or equivalent experience as determined by the board pursuant to division (A)(5) of section 4764.05 of the Revised Code

supervision_model.value: direct - supervisor on site 100% of time
supervision_model.quote: A licensed home inspector observes and evaluates the applicant during the inspection to verify the applicant's compliance with the standards of practice specified in rules adopted by the Ohio home inspector board

general_liability_minimum_coverage.quote: a comprehensive general liability insurance policy or a commercial general liability insurance policy with coverage limits of not less than one hundred thousand dollars per occurrence and not less than a three-hundred-thousand-dollar aggregate limit

pre_inspection_agreement_required.quote: No person shall perform a home inspection unless it is performed pursuant to a written contract entered into between a licensed home inspector and a client.

report_must_list_uninspected_components.quote: A list of any systems or components that were designated for inspection in the standards of practice adopted by the board under division (A)(10) of section 4764.05 of the Revised Code but that were not inspected

entity_license_required.quote: The superintendent shall not issue a license to a corporation, limited liability company, partnership, or association, although a licensed home inspector may sign a home inspection report in a representative capacity on behalf of any of those types of entities.

inspection_report_record_retention_years.quote: Every licensed home inspector shall retain for a period of five years the original or a true copy of each written contract for the licensee's services relating to home inspection work, all home inspection reports, and all work file documentation and data assembled in preparing those reports.

code_compliance_inspection_excluded.quote: "Home inspection" does not include ... determination of compliance with applicable statutes, rules, resolutions, or ordinances, including, without limitation, building, zoning, or historic codes.
